items.title: Why Is Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Expanding Its Role In AI Infrastructure?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) and NetApp expanded their alliance to deliver validated AI infrastructure for large enterprise deployments. The collaboration focuses on co-engineered compute and storage architectures designed for AI factories and large scale model training. The joint offering targets enterprise and sovereign AI projects that require data governance, cyber resilience, and scalable rollouts across cloud and on premises setups. items.title: Dell Is Quietly Riding One of the Biggest Tech Trends
items.summary: Dell's AI server business has exploded, its backlog dwarfs what most companies earn in a year, and the stock has already staged one of tech's most dramatic runs. The question now is whether supply constraints and a cash flow slide can derail what looks like a historic setup.

items.title: NetApp’s AI Opportunity Can Support Higher Growth, Says BofA — Raises Target After INSIGHT Event
items.summary: According to TheFly, BofA lifted its NetApp price target after attending INSIGHT 2026, assigning a higher valuation multiple to the additional addressable market it sees emerging from artificial intelligence.
